mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (at or below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates a weak labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is above 8.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (year-over-year) exceeds 2.0% and unemployment rate is below 5.0%, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDP growth (yoy) > 2.0% and UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (federal funds rate rising above 1.0% over a 3-month period), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0% and rising for 3 months, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 700.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction and a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 700.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price index growth (yoy) exceeds 2.5% and federal funds rate is below 0.5%, the market perceives inflation as transitory and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy growth > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A residential fixed investment (RSAFS) level below 400,000 million dollars signals weak housing investment and a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS is below 400000.0, or the Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
